text:
maria: Heads up — Channel partner NorthCloud's March invoice INV-2026-0342 landed with a negative balance: -$12,450. Looks like duplicated seat rows for eu-west-1 and eu-west-2. Can the billing team confirm before I draft a credit memo?
sam: on it, do we have the raw CSV/ledger lines? can you paste the rows you saw?
maria: sure, here's the snippet I pulled from the marketplace report:
```
subscription_id,region,sku,quantity,amount
sub_9988,eu-west-1,redwood-seat,120,12000
sub_9988,eu-west-2,redwood-seat,120,12000
sub_9988,eu-west-1,redwood-seat,120,12000  # duplicated row from parser
```
leo: whoa duplicate indeed. looks like eu-west-1 repeated with full qty. that would create an over-credit on the invoice when we normalize by subscription id.
ashley-fin: if the final credit exceeds $10k we need controller/CFO approval and GL mapping. what's the exact net impact after fees/taxes?
maria: portal calc shows -12,450 after marketplace fees and VAT reversal. invoice PDF attached in the thread (link) and the raw export is with billing-bot.
billing-bot: automated-export: marketplace_azure_march_2026.csv uploaded to /finance/partner-uploads/NorthCloud/INV-2026-0342.csv
sam: quick check — is this an ingestion bug or upstream from Azure? I can diff the API export vs our parser. assigning to myself: BILL-1128 created.
sam: preliminary find: our parser grouped by (subscription_id, region, sku) but a race in the ingestion produced duplicate report rows for eu-west-1; Azure sent two identical lines in one webhook batch.
leo: ok so upstream duplication. recommend we (1) issue credit memo to correct partner, (2) flag ingestion to drop exact duplicate rows, (3) notify partner ops so they can verify webhook dedupe on their side.
ashley-fin: agree on remediation. For the credit memo, do we prefer a direct negative invoice (credit note) or apply credit to next cycle? Partner prefers refund if they already reconciled. we need partner consent.
maria: I'll ping NorthCloud ops now: @northcloud-ops can you confirm whether you'd like a refund or credit applied to next invoice? (internal note: partner usually prefers credit).
leo: for internal routing, use revenue code REV-API-1 and GL 4102 for the reversal entry. tagging accounting.
cfo-june: I can approve the credit memo for up to $25k. please attach a one-line justification and the cleaned ledger export when you request signoff.
sam: will produce cleaned ledger and a one-line justification: "Duplicate ingestion rows from Azure webhook resulted in double-counted seats; credit issued to correct billing."
maria: timeline: I'll wait for partner response, draft the credit memo in NetSuite, attach cleaned export and justification, then route to @cfo-june for signoff. if partner asks for refund, we'll process payment run after approval.
ashley-fin: sound plan. please cc finance-ops when you route.
maria: done — created NetSuite draft CM-2026-089 and linked BILL-1128. I'll update this thread when partner replies. :thumbsup:
sam: noted, adding a parser dedupe unit test and scheduled hotfix for ingestion.
leo: logging follow-up: FILE-NC-INV-0342 in postmortem queue so we track prevention steps.
maria: thanks all, closing loop once partner confirms. :)
